ideas.name: Kindle Content Hub
ideas.problem: Jailbroken Kindle users struggle to organize and access their content efficiently. This app provides a centralized platform for managing sideloaded books, documents, and custom scripts, offering a better reading experience for enthusiasts.
ideas.monetization: Freemium with advanced features (sync, organization tools) for a one-time purchase of $9.99.

ideas.monetization: Sponsorships from relevant tech/art companies and premium features for artists (e.g., higher resolution uploads, analytics) for $5/month.

ideas.name: Startup Roadmap Buyer

ideas.monetization: SaaS B2B tiered pricing based on project complexity and user seats, starting at $49/month.

ideas.name: Freelance Equity Negotiator
ideas.problem: Freelancers and early employees are unsure if equity packages offered by startups are fair, leading to potential future disputes. This platform provides data-driven insights and negotiation templates to help individuals assess and negotiate startup equity.
ideas.monetization: Pay-per-report ($19.99) or a subscription for unlimited reports and access to negotiation guides ($9.99/month).

ideas.name: Lisp/Forth Code Translator

ideas.monetization: SaaS with tiered pricing based on translation volume and complexity, starting at $25/month for individual developers.
